integrity: The universal bound is proved analytically; exact-rational finite checks are corroborative only. Literature overlap searches are not exhaustive and no independent audit or validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact constant is for the l-infinity metric on triangle side-length triples, not the optimal Euclidean vertex-perturbation constant or a higher-dimensional simplex constant; sharpness is approached at a degenerate boundary triangle.
title: Sharp side-distance Lipschitz constant for triangle strength
